LanguageData.LP_WS_Counterspell.label: counterspell
LanguageData.LP_WS_Counterspell.description: Circle 3 (Abjuration): stay on guard for 30 seconds: the next spell or psychic ability an enemy casts within 20 cells is interrupted (-15% success per level the opponent's ability is above 3).
LanguageData.LP_WS_Polymorph.label: polymorph
LanguageData.LP_WS_Polymorph.description: Circle 4 (Transmutation): enemies have a 50% chance to turn into rabbits for 1 minute (can't hold weapons or use abilities, manipulation -90%, movement ×0.6, can only bite for 1 damage); allies instead become grizzly bears for 1 hour (as the druid's wild shape).
LanguageData.LP_WS_Stoneskin.label: stoneskin
LanguageData.LP_WS_Stoneskin.description: Circle 4 (Abjuration, concentration): one ally within 20 cells for 1 hour takes ×0.6 sharp, blunt and piercing damage.
LanguageData.LP_WS_WallOfFire.label: wall of fire
LanguageData.LP_WS_WallOfFire.description: Circle 4 (Evocation, concentration): raise an 8-cell-long wall of fire at a point within 20 cells (perpendicular to the cast direction) for 1 minute: enemies on the wall take 10 × arcane power fire damage per second.
LanguageData.LP_WS_BlackTentacles.label: black tentacles
LanguageData.LP_WS_BlackTentacles.description: Circle 4 (Conjuration, concentration): black tentacles sprout in radius 3 at a point within 20 cells for 1 minute: enemies have a 55% chance to be grappled (rooted for 5 seconds), and the grappled take 6 × arcane power blunt damage per second.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Banishment.label: banishment
LanguageData.LP_WS_Banishment.description: Circle 4 (Abjuration, concentration): one enemy within 20 cells has a 60% chance to be banished: demons, devils, elementals and other outsiders are sent home permanently (vanishing with their gear, leaving no corpse); other targets disappear for 1 minute and then return to their spot (early if the caster loses concentration).
LanguageData.LP_WS_Confusion.label: confusion
LanguageData.LP_WS_Confusion.description: Circle 4 (Enchantment): each enemy within radius 3 at a point within 20 cells has a 55% chance to go mad for 15 seconds (attacking anyone nearby).
LanguageData.LP_WS_PhantasmalKiller.label: phantasmal killer
LanguageData.LP_WS_PhantasmalKiller.description: Circle 4 (Illusion, concentration): one enemy within 20 cells has a 55% chance every 2 seconds for 30 seconds to take 10 × arcane power psychic damage and be frightened.
LanguageData.LP_WS_ArcaneEye.label: arcane eye
LanguageData.LP_WS_ArcaneEye.description: Circle 4 (Divination): send an invisible magic eye to a point within 60 cells, revealing the fog in radius 15.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Fabricate.label: fabricate
LanguageData.LP_WS_Fabricate.description: Circle 4 (Transmutation, ritual): on a workbench within 10 cells: its first doable bill instantly completes one item (work ≤ 3000 × arcane power, quality based on the wizard's own skill), materials consumed as usual. Once per day.
LanguageData.LP_WS_FaithfulHound.label: faithful hound
LanguageData.LP_WS_FaithfulHound.description: Circle 4 (Conjuration, ritual): summon an invisible watchdog beside you for 8 hours (a colony hound, invisible, with a harder bite; can't be tamed or taken along, dissipates when time is up): sends a warning letter when enemies come within 15 cells of it.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Blight.label: blight
LanguageData.LP_WS_Blight.description: Circle 4 (Necromancy): one enemy within 20 cells takes 30 × arcane power necrotic damage (×1.5 against insectoids and plant creatures); plants within radius 3 of it wither.
LanguageData.LP_WS_ConeOfCold.label: cone of cold
LanguageData.LP_WS_ConeOfCold.description: Circle 5 (Evocation): blast a 10-cell cone of cold in one direction; enemies inside take 40 × arcane power cold damage and frostbite.
LanguageData.LP_WS_DominatePerson.label: dominate person
LanguageData.LP_WS_DominatePerson.description: Circle 5 (Enchantment, concentration): one humanlike enemy within 20 cells has a 50% chance to be dominated, joining the colony to fight for 1 minute (can be drafted); afterwards it returns to its original side and is stunned for 5 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WS_HoldMonster.label: hold monster
LanguageData.LP_WS_HoldMonster.description: Circle 5 (Enchantment, upcastable): one hostile creature within 20 cells (humanlike, animal, insectoid or monster, except mechanoids) has a 50% chance to be paralyzed for 6 seconds. Upcast: each extra circle holds another within 6 cells of it.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Telekinesis.label: telekinesis
LanguageData.LP_WS_Telekinesis.description: Circle 5 (Transmutation): within 10 cells: an item is brought to your side (no weight limit); an ally is pulled to your side; an enemy has a 55% chance to be thrown 6 cells, taking 10 × arcane power blunt damage and stunned for 2 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WS_ConjureElemental.label: conjure elemental
LanguageData.LP_WS_ConjureElemental.description: Circle 5 (Conjuration, concentration): choose fire / water / earth / air in the window to summon a matching genasi warrior beside you who fights for the colony for 1 hour (dissipating early if the caster loses concentration).
LanguageData.LP_WS_TeleportationCircle.label: teleportation circle
LanguageData.LP_WS_TeleportationCircle.description: Circle 5 (Conjuration, ritual): cast on an empty space to carve a permanent teleportation circle (3×3); cast on an existing circle to send the people and things on its 3×3 to another teleportation circle (the main base's preferred).
LanguageData.LP_WS_ModifyMemory.label: modify memory
LanguageData.LP_WS_ModifyMemory.description: Circle 5 (Enchantment, ritual): on one person within 5 cells. Prisoner: recruit resistance × (1 - 50% × arcane power) (minimum 0); colonist: choose a negative memory in the window to delete.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Scrying.label: scrying
LanguageData.LP_WS_Scrying.description: Circle 5 (Divination, ritual): once every 3 days: a letter lists the threat events already scheduled within 3 days (how many days left and which events), and estimates the size of a raid from the colony's current wealth and population.
LanguageData.LP_WS_LegendLore.label: legend lore
LanguageData.LP_WS_LegendLore.description: Circle 5 (Divination, ritual): once every 15 days: learn the whereabouts of a legendary treasure, generating a vanilla "item stash" quest with an extra excellent-quality DND magic item in the stash (if no quest can be generated, the item appears beside the wizard directly).
LanguageData.LP_WS_ChainLightning.label: chain lightning
LanguageData.LP_WS_ChainLightning.description: Circle 6 (Evocation): a target within 24 cells takes 30 × arcane power lightning damage, then it jumps to up to 5 other enemies within 10 cells, ×0.85 per jump; mechanoids also short-circuit (stunned 2 seconds). Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WS_WallOfForce.label: wall of force
LanguageData.LP_WS_WallOfForce.description: Circle 6 (Evocation): raise an 8-cell-long transparent wall of force at a point within 20 cells (perpendicular to the cast direction) that blocks bullets and melee, 300 × arcane power durability per cell, dissipating after 30 seconds. Cooldown 60 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WS_TrueSeeing.label: true seeing
LanguageData.LP_WS_TrueSeeing.description: Circle 6 (Divination): one ally within 20 cells sees through invisibility for 1 hour (invisible enemies within 30 cells are revealed) and is unaffected by magical darkness and blindness; on casting, like a true seeing scroll, it dispels mind flayer control on the map and identifies cursed items.
LanguageData.LP_WS_CircleOfDeath.label: circle of death
LanguageData.LP_WS_CircleOfDeath.description: Circle 6 (Necromancy): a ring of death of radius 6 at a point within 20 cells, harming only enemies: 35 × arcane power necrotic damage.
LanguageData.LP_WS_FleshToStone.label: flesh to stone
LanguageData.LP_WS_FleshToStone.description: Circle 6 (Transmutation): one enemy within 20 cells has a 45% chance to gain a stone mark (growing slower and slower), slowed for 10 seconds even on failure; at 3 marks in total it begins full petrification (as a flesh to stone scroll, body size 2 or less).
LanguageData.LP_WS_MoveEarth.label: move earth
LanguageData.LP_WS_MoveEarth.description: Circle 6 (Transmutation, ritual): up to 30 cells of natural rock wall near a point within 20 cells are dug out directly, with 50% mineral yield (buildings and cells with artificial walls are left alone).
LanguageData.LP_WS_Contingency.label: contingency
LanguageData.LP_WS_Contingency.description: Circle 6 (Conjuration): pre-store one self spell in the window (shield, false life, blink, stoneskin, mage armor, mirror image); within 10 days it's cast automatically for free when you're downed or lose over half your health; only one can be stored.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Sunbeam.label: sunbeam
LanguageData.LP_WS_Sunbeam.description: Circle 6 (Evocation, concentration): fire a 20-cell beam of sunlight from yourself; enemies along the line take 30 × arcane power radiant damage and are blinded for 10 seconds; for 1 minute (while concentrating), firing again costs no mana with a 6-second cooldown.
LanguageData.LP_WS_CreateUndead.label: create undead
LanguageData.LP_WS_CreateUndead.description: Circle 6 (Necromancy): turn a humanlike corpse within 10 cells and up to 2 more within 5 cells of it into permanent ghoul servants (a lich's skeleton servants, counting as undead servants).
LanguageData.LP_WS_DelayedBlastFireball.label: delayed blast fireball
LanguageData.LP_WS_DelayedBlastFireball.description: Circle 7 (Evocation, chargeable): place a glowing bead of fire at a point within 24 cells that explodes after the charge seconds (pick 0-5 seconds via the right-click button or the spellbook): radius 5, (20 + 10 × charge seconds) × arcane power fire damage (70 at full charge).
LanguageData.LP_WS_DimensionDoor.label: dimension door
LanguageData.LP_WS_DimensionDoor.description: Circle 7 (Conjuration, twice per day): you and up to 2 allies nearby teleport together to any explored, standable position on the map, no line of sight needed.
LanguageData.LP_WS_FingerOfDeath.label: finger of death
LanguageData.LP_WS_FingerOfDeath.description: Circle 7 (Necromancy): one enemy within 24 cells takes 60 × arcane power necrotic damage; humanlikes killed by it immediately rise as permanent zombie servants of the colony (a lich's skeleton servants).
LanguageData.LP_WS_ReverseGravity.label: reverse gravity
LanguageData.LP_WS_ReverseGravity.description: Circle 7 (Transmutation, concentration): gravity reverses in radius 5 at a point within 20 cells: enemies float for 10 seconds unable to move, taking 15 × arcane power blunt damage on landing (landing early if the caster loses concentration).
LanguageData.LP_WS_Etherealness.label: etherealness
LanguageData.LP_WS_Etherealness.description: Circle 7 (Transmutation): step onto the Ethereal Plane yourself for 1 hour: enemies won't target you and you take no damage; attacking or casting a damaging spell brings you back early (can't pass through walls).
LanguageData.LP_WS_PlaneShift.label: plane shift
LanguageData.LP_WS_PlaneShift.description: Circle 7 (Conjuration): one enemy within 20 cells has a 50% chance to be permanently sent to another plane (vanishing with its gear). While in a caravan, the caravan button "plane shift" instantly returns the whole party to the colony (costs this wizard 5 mana).
LanguageData.LP_WS_MagnificentMansion.label: magnificent mansion
LanguageData.LP_WS_MagnificentMansion.description: Circle 7 (Conjuration, ritual): cast with the caravan button "magnificent mansion" while the caravan is out (costs 5 mana): for 8 hours the caravan won't be ambushed, everyone's rest recovery ×1.2, mood +10. Cast on a map, it only gives this effect to allies within 5 cells.
LanguageData.LP_WS_ForceCage.label: forcecage
LanguageData.LP_WS_ForceCage.description: Circle 8 (Evocation): build a force cage of radius 2 at a point within 20 cells for 20 seconds: enemies inside can't get out, bullets can't pass in or out, and it can't be resisted.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Maze.label: maze
LanguageData.LP_WS_Maze.description: Circle 8 (Conjuration): one enemy within 20 cells is locked in an extradimensional maze and returns to its spot after 30 seconds; 90% success against ordinary enemies, 50% against legendary creatures and story bosses.
LanguageData.LP_WS_DominateMonster.label: dominate monster
LanguageData.LP_WS_DominateMonster.description: Circle 8 (Enchantment, concentration): any one hostile creature within 20 cells (including animals, insectoids and mechanoids) has a 45% chance to be dominated for 1 minute, fighting for the colony; afterwards it returns to its original side and is stunned for 5 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Feeblemind.label: feeblemind
LanguageData.LP_WS_Feeblemind.description: Circle 8 (Enchantment): one enemy within 20 cells takes 30 × arcane power psychic damage, with a 50% chance to be unable to cast spells or use psychic abilities for 30 days.
LanguageData.LP_WS_MindBlank.label: mind blank
LanguageData.LP_WS_MindBlank.description: Circle 8 (Abjuration): one ally within 20 cells is immune to psychic damage, mental breaks and all mind control for 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Antipathy.label: antipathy
LanguageData.LP_WS_Antipathy.description: Circle 8 (Enchantment, ritual): radius 12 around yourself for 10 days; choose one type in the window (humanlikes / insectoids / animals / mechanoids): hostile units of that type entering have a 50% chance to be driven out by a wave of revulsion (pushed out of the area and stopped for 1 second).
LanguageData.LP_WS_Sunburst.label: sunburst
LanguageData.LP_WS_Sunburst.description: Circle 8 (Evocation): blazing sunlight bursts in radius 6 at a point within 24 cells, harming only enemies: 40 × arcane power radiant damage and blinded for 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Clone.label: clone
LanguageData.LP_WS_Clone.description: Circle 8 (Necromancy, ritual): requires the Biotech DLC and a growth vat on the map: start growing your own clone, which matures in 15 days. Once the clone matures the wizard dies and the soul moves into the clone: waking at the main base with skills, levels, classes and traits kept; gear on the body stays where they died. Liches can't use it.
LanguageData.LP_WS_TimeStop.label: time stop
LanguageData.LP_WS_TimeStop.description: Circle 9 (Transmutation): everyone on the map except yourself freezes for 6 seconds (damage doesn't break it); during these 6 seconds wizard spells trigger no cooldown after casting.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Wish.label: wish
LanguageData.LP_WS_Wish.description: Circle 9 (Conjuration, once every 7 days): choose one in the window: cast any wizard spell of circle 8 or lower for free / fully heal all colonists on the map / revive one colonist / summon a legendary-quality DND magic item. The last two have a 33% chance of backlash: manipulation and movement sharply reduced for 3 days, with another 33% chance to permanently lose Wish.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Gate.label: gate
LanguageData.LP_WS_Gate.description: Circle 9 (Conjuration): open a planar gate beside you and choose one in the window: summon a demon / devil from the Abyss or the Nine Hells to fight for the colony for 1 hour, or have a caravan of a friendly faction walk straight out of the gate.
LanguageData.LP_WS_PowerWordKill.label: power word kill
LanguageData.LP_WS_PowerWordKill.description: Circle 9 (Enchantment): one enemy within 24 cells that has already lost over half its health (health ≤ 50%) dies outright; legendary creatures and story bosses take 100 × arcane power psychic damage instead. Ordinary enemies not yet past half take only 30 × arcane power psychic damage.
LanguageData.LP_WS_Foresight.label: foresight
LanguageData.LP_WS_Foresight.description: Circle 9 (Divination): one ally within 20 cells for 8 hours: 50% chance to dodge when attacked, melee hit +25%, shooting accuracy ×1.25.
LanguageData.LP_WS_MassPolymorph.label: mass polymorph
LanguageData.LP_WS_MassPolymorph.description: Circle 9 (Transmutation): up to 10 enemies within radius 4 at a point within 20 cells each have a 50% chance to turn into rabbits for 1 minute (as polymorph).
